# ID42 Studio
> Software, AI and intelligent solutions studio. We design, build and operate software systems, intelligent applications and digital products — engineering first, AI when it adds value.

## Pages
- [Português](https://id42studio.github.io/): default locale
- [English](https://id42studio.github.io/en/): English version

## What we do
- Software engineering: custom systems, web applications, backend services, APIs, SaaS platforms
- AI and agentic systems: agents, multi-agent systems, copilots, RAG, LLM applications, evaluation
- Automation and integration: ERP/CRM integration, workflow automation, APIs, event-driven pipelines
- Product engineering: discovery, MVP, SaaS engineering, product architecture, evolution
- Architecture and consulting: solution architecture, technical review, modernisation, AI adoption
- Research and prototyping: applied R&D, proofs of concept, experiments, open source

## How we work
Discover, Architect, Build, Validate, Operate, Evolve. The same six stages apply to conventional
software, AI, integrations, digital products and experiments.

## Projects
- [VBSell](https://vbsell.com): omnichannel sales platform with WhatsApp AI agents that answer, qualify, follow up and log into the CRM
- [BuilderMonitor](https://buildermonitor.cloud.escodoo.com): enterprise SaaS radar for construction sites — schedule, cost and field data above the ERP
- [Deepze](https://deepze.ai): private enterprise AI with chat and copilots over the company knowledge base, RAG on customer infrastructure

## Labs
ID42 Labs is the studio's applied research and prototyping practice: agents and multi-agent systems,
local and private LLMs, developer tooling, open source, emerging architectures and applied AI evaluation.
